title: 부탁할 때: 좀 빌려주세요, 좀 도와주세요
objective: By the end, you can ask for help or to borrow something in a short polite sentence, and you can tell 빌리다 (borrow) apart from 빌려주다 (lend).
summary: Learn ten everyday words for asking someone a favor, borrowing and lending things, and offering or accepting help.

task.title: Use the favor words
task.line: Choose, fill in, put in order, or write a short answer using the words on page 1.

words.meaning: to ask someone to do something for you; to ask a favor
words.exampleMeaning: I asked a friend to help me move.

words.meaning: to borrow (you get something for a while)
to lend (you give something for a while)
to help (out); changes to 도와요 / 도왔어요
words.exampleMeaning: On the weekend I helped out at my parents' shop.

words.meaning: to help someone (do something for them); used in requests
words.exampleMeaning: My bags are too heavy. Please help me.

words.meaning: to need; to be needed (the thing you need takes 이/가)
words.exampleMeaning: If you need help, just tell me.

words.meaning: for a moment; for a short time
words.exampleMeaning: Can I use your phone for a moment?

words.meaning: of course (a friendly yes to a request)
words.exampleMeaning: Of course. Go ahead and use it.

words.meaning: to give back; to return (something you borrowed)
words.exampleMeaning: I'll give the book back next week.

words.meaning: a softening word in requests, like 'please'
words.exampleMeaning: Could you pass me the salt, please?

exercises: Choose 빌렸어요 or 빌려줬어요: ① 친구가 저에게 만 원을 (빌렸어요 / 빌려줬어요). ② 저는 도서관에서 사전을 (빌렸어요 / 빌려줬어요). ③ 민수 씨가 옆 사람에게서 지우개를 (빌렸어요 / 빌려줬어요).
Fill in the blank with the past polite form of 돕다: 어제 옆집 할머니 이사를 ____.
Fill in each blank with one word from page 1: ① 감기약이 ____. 약국에 가야 해요. ② 숙제가 너무 어려워요. 그래서 선생님께 도움을 ____했어요.
Choose the best reply: A: 우산 좀 빌려줄 수 있어요? B: (물론이에요 / 필요해요). 여기 있어요.
Put the words in order to make a request: 좀 / 저 / 도와주세요 / 잠깐
Answer in Korean with 돌려주다: Your friend lent you a book. Tell them you will give it back tomorrow.
answers: ① 빌려줬어요 ② 빌렸어요 ③ 빌렸어요
잠깐 저 좀 도와주세요. (저 좀 잠깐 도와주세요. / 저 잠깐 좀 도와주세요.)
내일 돌려줄게요. (책은 내일 돌려줄게요. / 내일 돌려줄게.)
